# Attribution

This skill is adapted from the `context-engineering` skill in
[addyosmani/agent-skills](https://github.com/addyosmani/agent-skills/blob/main/skills/context-engineering/SKILL.md),
published under the MIT License, Copyright © 2025 Addy Osmani.

The Sanofi version retains the upstream's core ideas — context hierarchy,
deliberate curation, confusion management, anti-pattern framing — and adds
guidance specific to Sanofi repositories:

- Integration with `@sanofi-accelerator/ai-standards` and the skill registry
- Multi-runtime coordination (Claude Code, Codex)
- Sanofi file references (`catalog-info.yaml`, `docs/adr/`, Atlassian MCP)
- Implementation rules (200-line CLAUDE.md cap, prefer skill auto-loading)
- Drop-in `CLAUDE.md` template pre-wired for the standards catalog
